handoff.salientSummary: Implemented raw_manifest preinstall kind in scenario schema and apply-scenario.sh, updated envoy-gateway primer to OCI chart, and created envoy-gateway scenario YAML. All 15 new bats tests pass, all 5 pre-F1.2 scenarios validate with no regression, and cluster hygiene is clean.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Extended engine/templates/scenario.schema.json with a oneOf discriminator on preinstall_item: 'helm' sub-schema (default when kind omitted, backward compatible) and 'raw_manifest' sub-schema (requires kind+path, optional namespace, additionalProperties:false). Refactored apply-scenario.sh to dispatch on kind field: helm items use existing helm upgrade --install path, raw_manifest items resolve path (local file or URL) and run kubectl apply -f with optional --namespace. Replaced defunct https://gateway.envoyproxy.io/helm-chart repo URL with oci://docker.io/envoyproxy/gateway-helm in the envoy-gateway primer. Created envoy-gateway scenario YAML using raw_manifest for Gateway API CRDs and OCI helm chart for the controller. Added 15 bats test cases covering schema validation (raw_manifest with/without path, unknown kinds, extra properties, helm backward compat, mixed lists), apply-scenario.sh dispatch logic (function existence, unknown-kind rejection, tempfile cleanup, URL handling, missing-path detection), and envoy-gateway scenario schema validation. Added test fixture ConfigMap for raw_manifest bats tests. Updated scenario template with raw_manifest documentation.
handoff.whatWasLeftUndone: VAL-ENGINE-008 (real kubectl apply of raw_manifest on a kind cluster) and VAL-ENGINE-010 (end-to-end envoy-gateway scenario run on kind) require spinning up a real cluster and were not executed in this session — the schema, script, and test logic are fully implemented but these integration-level assertions need a cluster to verify. The cluster-lifecycle bats test suite (which attempts real minikube spin-up) timed out during the full-suite run; the targeted bats files (raw-manifest-preinstall.bats, schema.bats, prefix-invariant.bats) all pass cleanly.

commandsRun.observation: 23 bats tests, all passing. 15 raw-manifest tests + 3 schema tests + 5 prefix-invariant tests.
No warnings of severity 'warning' or above. One pre-existing SC2005 style issue in resolve_project_dir (not introduced by this change).

commandsRun.command: for f in scenarios/*.yaml; do yq -o=json $f | jsonschema -i /dev/stdin scenario.schema.json; done
commandsRun.observation: All 6 scenario YAMLs (5 pre-F1.2 + envoy-gateway) validate OK against the updated schema.
OCI chart reference found in both primer (1 match) and scenario (1 match).
0 matches for defunct URL in both files (exit 1 = grep found nothing, which is correct).

commandsRun.observation: No chart-test-swarm-* entries in kind, minikube, or docker. Clean cluster hygiene.
